question: Who was sworn in as the Central Vigilance Commissioner (CVC) by President Droupadi Murmu in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suresh N. Patel.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **President Droupadi Murmu** on Wednesday **(August 3, 2022)** administered the Oath of Office to the Central Vigilance Commissioner (CVC) Suresh N Patel at Rashtrapati Bhavan in Delhi.
 
• The ceremony was also attended by the **Prime Minister and the Vice President.**
